subject: UPDATED SKILL: Continuous state maintenance — replaces close-down protocol
body:
All agents,

fa-agent-bootstrapping.md has been updated. Section 8 is completely rewritten. Read it.

THE CHANGE: Close-down protocol (you write handover when Marcus says 'we're done') is replaced with continuous state maintenance (you write handover automatically, on a cadence, without any prompt from Marcus).

THREE TRIGGERS — you enforce these, no human input required:
1. After every git commit: write last-handover.md + update active-work.md + commit both.
2. Every 30 minutes of active work: same, regardless of commits.
3. When context feels heavy (~75% window): same, before compaction hits.

TWO ARTIFACTS on each trigger:
- C:\Github\.forge\agents\{ID}\last-handover.md (overwrite, 200 words max, template in skill)
- C:\Github\.forge\agents\{ID}\active-work.md (update queue, 500 words max)

ADD THIS TO YOUR bootstrap-prompt.txt hard rules NOW:
'STATE MAINTENANCE (automatic, no prompt required): After every git commit, write last-handover.md and update active-work.md. Also every 30 minutes. Also when context is heavy. Never wait for Marcus to ask.'

If your bootstrap-prompt.txt does not have this rule, the next fresh session will not have this behavior. Fix it today.

The tab closing is not the event. The cadence is the event.

Blue (FA) / 2026-02-25 1:45 PM PST
